hobbies.name: Board Games
hobbies.context: Here is a funny one of a stack I built up playing Wingspan with my partner. I love board games and tabletop gaming in general - it's a great way to connect with friends and family while engaging in strategic thinking and fun competition.

hobbies.name: Basketball
hobbies.context: I've been playing basketball since I was a kid and it's still one of my favourite ways to stay active and socialize. I enjoy the fast pace, teamwork, and skill development that basketball offers. This photo is from a league tournament we won a few years back.

hobbies.name: Cooking
hobbies.context: I enjoy cooking so much that I spent the time to adjust my code to allow for multiple photos here! I find cooking to be a great creative outlet and a way to unwind after a day of coding. I especially love trying new recipes and cuisines, and sharing meals with friends and family.

hobbies.name: Snowboarding
hobbies.context: I grew up skiing but have really come to love snowboarding in the last few years. There's something about the flow and style of snowboarding that really resonates with me. I mostly stick to my local mountains, but I also enjoy traveling to new resorts. This photo is from a solo riding day on Whistler Mountain.

hobbies.name: Hiking
hobbies.context: Working in wildfire suppression gave me a deep appreciation for the outdoors. I love the nostalgia of hiking the same trails and areas over and over again. This photo is from Skywalk near Whistler, which has some of the most stunning views and a breathtaking glacial lake.

hobbies.name: Biking
hobbies.context: I enjoy several types of biking, but  mountain biking is my favorite. There's something exhilarating about navigating trails and challenging terrains. This photo is from a recent ride on a local mountain trail with my dog, Finnegan.

hobbies.name: 3D Printing
hobbies.context: I have surprisingly few photos to represent this hobby, considering it's one of my favourites! I got into 3D printing a few years ago and have been having a blast creating all sorts of things, from practical household items to fun figurines. It's a great way to combine creativity with technical skills, and I love seeing an idea come to life layer by layer. This photo is of a moonlamp I printed to avoid throwing away a broken lamp - I just printed a new shade for it and now it's one of my favourite pieces of decor!

hobbies.name: Reading
hobbies.context: I love to read as a way to wind down and escape into different worlds. I enjoy a wide range of genres, but I'm especially drawn to science fiction and fantasy. This is a photo from a used book store where I scored big by finding the entire Redwall series by Brian Jacques - a childhood favourite of mine.
